html:
G'oya

Qoida ikki pog'onali, so'rov ham ikki qadam. Birinchi ROW_NUMBER har maktab ichida o'quvchilarni ball bo'yicha raqamlaydi, birinchisi maktab da'vogari. Ikkinchi ROW_NUMBER faqat da'vogarlarni viloyat ichida raqamlaydi, birinchi ikkitasi o'tadi. Ikkala tartib ham to'liq aniq: teng ballda id hal qiladi. Har bir qadam jadvalni bir marta saralaydi.

Yechim

WITH best AS (
  SELECT id, name, region, score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region, school ORDER BY score DESC, id) AS in_school
  FROM contestants
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region, name, score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY score DESC, id) AS in_region
  FROM best
  WHERE in_school = 1
)
SELECT region, name, score
FROM ranked
WHERE in_region <= 2

Maktab PARTITION BY region, school: nomning o'zi yetmaydi. Namunada Toshkentdagi Malika 92 ball bilan ikkinchi o'rinda turibdi, lekin u Aziz bilan bitta maktabdan, shuning uchun o'rniga 5-maktabdagi Bekzod o'tadi.

Tuzoqlar

Maktab qadamini tashlab, viloyatda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ikkitasini olish Malika va Azizni o'tkazadi. Maktabni viloyatsiz ajratish esa Samarqanddagi 12-maktabni Toshkentdagi 12-maktab bilan bitta qiladi va Jasur da'vogarlikdan tushib qoladi.

Oyna funksiyasisiz yozish ham mumkin, lekin sekin. Har bir o'quvchi uchun "maktabimda mendan kuchli bormi" va "viloyatda mendan kuchli da'vogarlar nechta" degan ichki so'rovlar har qator uchun viloyatning hamma o'quvchilarini aylanib chiqadi:

SELECT c.region, c.name, c.score
FROM contestants c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contestants o
                  WHERE o.region = c.region AND o.school = c.school
                    AND (o.score > c.score OR (o.score = c.score AND o.id < c.id)))
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contestants o
       WHERE o.region = c.region
         AND (o.score > c.score OR (o.score = c.score AND o.id < c.id))
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contestants x
                         WHERE x.region = o.region AND x.school = o.school
                           AND (x.score > o.score OR (x.score = o.score AND x.id < o.id)))) < 2

RANK tenglarga bir xil o'rin beradi va maktabdan ikki kishi, viloyatdan uch kishi chiqib qolishi mumkin.
